native_reference_entry_guard: handleQuote cancels pending entry when ns>=flatten, entry not allowed, or executable quote past fixed stop. No filled trade in that case; consume signal and report exclusion. A valid entry can subsequently trigger a second-end exit intent with >=2s fill latency.
path_consensus: For every reachable prior finite state and both O-H-L-C/O-L-H-C orders require exactly one first-return event of identical side in the same second; otherwise no emitted candidate, record ambiguity, retain all reachable end states without using outcomes. All-zero-return second emits none and is not falsely called a trade.
completed_feature_clock: Preserve native pre-commit callback: slope/ATR and relative volume only from 5min bars whose end<=secondSTART. Current forming-bar stop/BB may include current second OHLC known at decisionEND. At exact5minboundary the just-finished bar is first used for completed-feature values in the NEXT second.
